'''Hall Jo'uda''' was a prominent commerce house on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. It helped finance a grand production of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
